claim: The one-click demo uses sample data without reading or changing the real casebook.
where: landing sample action, demo banner, privacy, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed real IndexedDB, enter /demo, change and reset sample data, then return to real data

claim: A review hides the decision until the learner chooses, then shows the decision and why the alternative does not fit.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; open inventory case, choose the alternative, reveal, and record the review

claim: Cases and reviews stay in this browser and persist across reloads.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; author a uniquely named case, reload, and inspect the demo IndexedDB database

claim: JSON export includes complete cases, attribution, and review history.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; download a backup and parse every required case and review field

claim: Import checks a backup before changing the casebook.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; import a malformed review, reload, and compare the original sample titles

claim: The product is installable as a PWA after an online visit.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; ask Chromium for the parsed manifest, load declared icons, and confirm an active service worker

claim: The app and saved cases reopen offline after the first online visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; load /demo online, wait for service worker control, go offline, and reload

claim: The free version stores up to 15 cases.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample without a license; try to replace it with a valid 16-case backup and confirm rejection

claim: A verified $19 one-time license removes the 15-case limit and shows recent review history.
where: landing pricing, license view, terms, README
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; use a recorded valid verification response, import 16 cases, and open recent history

claim: Normal use loads no analytics, advertising trackers, third-party fonts, or CDN scripts.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; record every request while opening and completing a sample review

claim: Authoring a case does not upload its content.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample; record request methods and bodies while authoring a uniquely marked case
